name: B10-0075/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
part_text:
The European Parliament is worried about Lithuania's public broadcaster, LRT. It says planned changes would make it easier to fire LRT's head, and a budget freeze would weaken the broadcaster. The Parliament says both break EU media freedom rules. It asks Lithuania to drop the changes, wait for expert legal advice, and give LRT stable funding. It also asks the European Commission to watch the situation and act if Lithuania does not comply. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- Planned Lithuanian rules would make firing LRT's head easier; Parliament wants them rejected.
- LRT's budget is frozen at 2025 levels for 2026–2028; Parliament wants stable funding.
- The European Commission is asked to monitor and possibly start legal action.
